subject.title: fix(gateway): bound session catalog refresh pressure

question: Should overloaded distinct `sessions.catalog.list` requests return briefly stale catalog data or `UNAVAILABLE`, rather than queueing additional provider scans?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes the caller-visible overload contract; focused tests establish mechanics but cannot determine whether stale data or explicit unavailability is the desired product behavior for catalog clients.

options.title: Accept bounded stale/unavailable admission
options.body: Keep the proposed coordinator after redacted real-process proof shows that duplicate requests share work and callers recover correctly after pressure clears.

options.title: Use a different overload contract
options.body: Pause this PR and define queueing, retry guidance, or another caller-visible behavior before merging the coordinator.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded stale/unavailable admission
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed coordinator after redacted real-process proof shows that duplicate requests share work and callers recover correctly after pressure clears.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work connects the session catalog to its Control UI consumer, where the caller-visible overload behavior must remain coherent.
